name: sdd-kit
description: Spec-driven delivery for any software project (web, mobile, backend): discovery, spec with How-it-works diagrams, plan, TDD implementation with two-verdict review, verification and a draft PR, behind three human gates. Coexists with other workflow plugins.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: sdd (recommended): hard stops everywhere, merge/deploy/publish/secret rails only in /sdd-kit:sdd runs and sdd agents. strict: rails in every session. hard-only: hard stops only. off: no guard.

format_on_edit.title: Format on edit
format_on_edit.description: During sdd-kit runs, run the project's own formatter after each edit.
